stories.title: ‘Beating Heart’ of Greenfield Valley Celebrated During Volunteers’ Week
stories.summary: Greenfield Valley Trust is celebrating the “beating heart” of the historic site as part of National Volunteers’ Week – while encouraging more local people to get involved in shaping its future. stories.title: Connah’s Quay Central by-election triggered as Bernie Attridge quits Flintshire Council
stories.summary: A by-election will be held in Connah’s Quay Central after Bernie Attridge resigned as a councillor on Monday, bringing to an end more than two decades on Flintshire County Council. stories.title: Three rare giant otter pups born at Chester Zoo take their first swimming lessons
stories.summary: Three giant otter pups born at Chester Zoo have had their first swimming lessons, 15 weeks after arriving in February.
